verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਨ ਜੋਤੀ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੁਇ ਪਤੰਗ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dharasan jot na jotee saroop hui pata(n)g sabadh surat mirag jugat na jaane hai ||

en.bdb: Like a moth, I do not sacrifice myself over the radiant glimpse True Guru, nor do I know the method of lodging the music of True Guru's words as is the wont of a deer;

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਨ ਮਧੁਪ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਓਗ ਹੁਇ ਨ ਮੀਨ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal makara(n)dh na madhup gat bireh biog hui na meen mar jaane hai ||

en.bdb: Like a bumble bee mad for the nectar of lotus flower loses his life when the flower closes, but I have not sacrificed myself unto the lotus like feet of my Satguru, nor have Known the pangs of separation from my Satguru like a fish when out of water;

verses.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਨ ਟਰਤ ਹੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਗਦ ਜੋਨਿ ਚਾਤੁਰ ਚਤੁਰ ਗੁਨ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਹਿਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ek ek Tek na Tarat hai tiragadh jon chaatur chatur gun hoi na hiraane hai ||

en.bdb: The living being of lower species do not backtrack their steps dying for their love that is based on just one virtue. But I with all my wisdom do not carry any trait like these beings, I do not sacrifice myself unto my True Guru creatures do;

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਹਨ ਕਠੋਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਮੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਮਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਮ ਨਰਕ ਲਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit_en: paahan kaThor satigur sukh saagar mai sun mam naam jam narak lajaane hai ||23||

en.bdb: Satguru is ocean of peace and tranquillity but I am like a stone (who is least influenced by any precept of the True Guru) despite living near Him. Hearing the name of a sinner like the messenger of hell would feel ashamed of me. (23)
